poses.caption: Support yourself on your forearm and bent knees, with the elbow under your shoulder. Lift your hips into a straight line from knees to head, hold, then switch sides.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1469 LATERAL SIDE PLANK BENT LEG. ONE STATIC HOLD exactly ONE full body person. Side-front three-quarter view head LEFT feet RIGHT on thin gray mat. Lie on LEFT side, BOTH knees bent90degrees and stacked, lower legs extend backward to RIGHT, stacked knees/shins contact mat supporting LOWER body. LEFT elbow/forearm planted directly BELOW shoulder, forearm points forward palm flat; elbow90deg. Raise HIPS CLEAR of floor to create straight diagonal line from LEFT shoulder through hip to KNEE, shoulders and hips stacked upright no forward/back roll. Head neutral along spine eyes forward no sag. Top RIGHT hand on upper hip relaxed. Only LEFT forearm and stacked bent knee/lower-leg support, not full straight-leg plank. Clearly visible gap under torso/hip. Primary ABS red only as diffuse educational RED tint over intact black tank front/lateral abdominal flank, no fibers or rectus/oblique segment lines visible through fabric. All exposed muscles grayscale detailed fine anatomy realistic hands proportions. Complete opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK covers waist and BLACK MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH continuous seams hems broad real cloth folds no transparency/cutaway. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins head elbows both bent legs shoes mat entirely inside square no crop. Equal male/female quality. Original project artwork rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup/chest red. No text labels captions arrows extra people.
jobs.inspectionNote: Two bent-knee side plank candidates, one static pose per variant, two built-in calls. Both BLOCKED for insufficient clear thigh/hip elevation above knee support. Forearm support, bent stacked legs, upper hand on hip and red abdominal tint over intact tank retained. Full opaque clothes and detailed exposed grayscale anatomy. Qualified elbow under shoulder, pelvis stacking, neck alignment and cloth tint need human review. Original project artwork rendering style only, no upstream licensed input. Exact prompts/originals retained. No anatomy or clothing approval or publication. Seven pipeline checks do not establish anatomical accuracy.
blockingIssues: Lower thigh/shorts contact the mat well above the knee, so elevated knee-supported hip position is not clearly demonstrated; male pelvis especially low.
